lines: And what was said: Samāveśa-full, enjoyer-natured Śiva; in interruptio
n of enjoyment-lust-enjoyment, of nature of restraint.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ
